ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: What is a history of emotions? How does the environment shape history? Can smell serve as a historical source? Can you write a contemporary history of a place where Jews no longer live and still present a Jewish perspective? “Historical Methods in Jewish Studies” covers these and many more research methodologies, concepts, and categories of analysis, covering territories from the Far East to the United States and from South Africa to Great Britain. Although the main focus is Jewish history and culture, the course will be of interest to all graduate students in humanities preparing to work on their dissertations.
